description: The Dimmer's words and paper at night, one copy for every app: the chart's white as MapLibre's raster shader draws it (raster-contrast about the middle, 1/(1-k) over 0 and 1+k under, then raster-brightness-max), the share of their night inks the map's light-haloed words take so that none is brighter than the paper under it (AIM 8-1-6, Vision in Flight: the pilot's dark adaptation), floored under the night's own contrast, and a night warning's light against the paper's. A display's look, not an aviation figure; its figures are design/tokens.json's map-dim group, its cases apps/web/src/lib/fixtures/mapDim.json.

night.description: After dark: by day the words take no share (0) and the warnings their whole light (1).

brightness.description: The chart's raster-brightness-max, 0 to 1 (held to it).

paper.description: The chart's white as drawn, encoded sRGB 0 to 1.

words.description: The share of their night inks the light-haloed words take, in hundredths: 0 by day, at least 0.01 at night.

warning.description: A night warning's colour's share of light, the paper's times map-dim.warning-under-paper, in hundredths; 1 by day.
